note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate, soldier and worker are all described, the alate description and measurements being taken from Akhtar (1976); synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brownish yellow; antennae uniform yellow; mandibles dark brown with yellowish brown bases; pronotum, legs and body yellowish white. Cephalic pilosity sparse, pronotal pilosity moderate, abdominal pilosity dense. Body length 4.85–6.80 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides slightly narrowed anteriorly, longer than wide (head length to mandible bases 1.65–2.00, maximum width 1.28–1.65 mm, width/length index 0.74–0.89). Antennae 15–16-segmented and short; segment 3 shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Labrum subtriangular, apex acute, about as long as wide, 0.26–0.33 mm. Mandibles sickle-shaped, slightly incurved near the apex, about two thirds of the head length (mandible length 1.05–1.23 mm, mandible length/head length index 0.55–0.65). Left mandible with a small tooth near the base of the middle third (tooth distance/mandible length index 0.60–0.66); right mandible toothless and without a basal process. Postmentum subrectangular (length 1.13–1.38, maximum width 0.53–0.70 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped, distinctly wider than long (length 0.55–0.75, maximum width 0.90–1.25 mm), anterior margin weakly concave medially, posterior margin distinctly incised; mesonotum narrower than the pronotum with a weakly concave posterior margin; metanotum as wide as the pronotum with a nearly straight posterior margin.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Workers monomorphic. Head capsule and antennae pale yellow, postclypeus slightly darker; legs and body yellowish white. Cephalic and body pilosity dense. Body length 3.90–5.50 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to the apex of the labrum 1.60–2.20, length to mandible bases 1.10–1.45, maximum width 1.25–2.50 mm). Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2, subequal to segment 4 or shorter than segment 4; segment 5 subequal to segment 3. Postclypeus inflated and setose, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum length 0.40–0.53, maximum width 0.63–0.85 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown, paler anteriorly; postclypeus distinctly paler than the head capsule, yellowish brown with a reddish tinge; pronotum slightly paler than the head capsule, with a yellow T-shaped mark in the middle and a shoulder spot at each anterolateral corner. Cephalic and body pilosity dense. Head capsule subcircular, the width including the compound eyes greater than the head length to the mandible bases (length to the apex of the labrum 2.39–2.81, length to mandible bases 1.67–1.80, width including compound eyes 2.22–2.39 mm). Fontanelle minute, situated medially. Compound eyes roundly oval and medium-sized (long diameter 0.55–0.61, short diameter 0.48–0.54 mm), 0.13–0.16 mm from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli oval, their distance from the compound eyes about equal to their short diameter (long diameter 0.25–0.29, short diameter 0.16–0.20, eye–ocellus distance 0.16–0.22 mm). Postclypeus inflated, about half as long as wide (length 0.48–0.52, width 0.94–0.99 mm). Antennae 19-segmented, segments 3 and 4 subequal, segment 5 shortest. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, anterior and posterior margins shallowly concave (length 1.12–1.16, width 2.13–2.31 mm).
